mapper.select: SELECT NEXTVAL('日程候補.日程候補番号')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO 日程候補.日程候補(日程候補番号, ミーティングID, 開始日時, 終了日時) VALUES (#{scheduleNumber}, #{meetingId.value}, #{startDateTime}, #{endDateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT 日程候補番号 as "scheduleNumber.value", CAST(開始日時 AS DATE) AS "scheduleConstruct.meetingDate.value", CAST(開始日時 AS TIME) AS "scheduleConstruct.startTime.value", CAST(終了日時 AS TIME) AS "scheduleConstruct.endTime.value" FROM 日程候補.日程候補 WHERE ミーティングid = #{meetingId.value} ORDER BY 開始日時 ASC, 終了日時 ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM 日程候補.日程候補 WHERE ミーティングid = #{meetingId.value}
